journey.name: Settings and Back Press Navigation
journey.description: Tests navigating to Settings, pressing system back to return to the Home screen, and verifying standard double-back-to-exit behavior.

actions.action: Ensure the app is on the Home screen
Tap the "Settings" tab in the bottom navigation bar
Verify that the Settings screen opens with storage location, app version, and preferences
Press the Android device back button once
Verify that the app returns to the Home tab and does not close
Verify that the My Files screen is displayed
Press the Android device back button once
Verify that the app returns to the Home tab and does not close
Press the Android device back button once while on the Home tab
Verify that the "Press back again to exit" toast appears and the app remains active
